calendar-plans.name: Bite Size Terror
calendar-plans.description: A bite-sized horror anthology where seemingly harmless encounters, desires, and decisions take terrifying turns.

calendar-plans.name: Dark Side: Riku Rantala & Kale Puonti
calendar-plans.description: A new Finnish true crime series in which Riku Rantala and Kalevi Puonti explore ten criminal cases from Finland. Cinematic, AI-generated dramatizations transport viewers right into the heart of the events. Keep the lights on—this is *Pimeä Puoli* (The Dark Side)!

calendar-plans.name: Debipokkho
calendar-plans.description: Ishani returns to the Sheel mansion when a sacred golden tongue goes missing, only to be blamed for the theft. As another shocking secret comes to light, she finds herself trapped among a family full of hidden motives. Two wills and a sinister riddle could change her fate forever.

add-cards.name: NCIS
add-cards.description: From murder and espionage to terrorism and stolen submarines, a team of special agents investigates any crime that has any connection to Navy and Marine Corps personnel, regardless of rank or position.

add-cards.name: Jungle
add-cards.description: In 1981, an enthusiastic young adventurer follows his dreams into the Bolivian Amazon jungle with two friends and a guide with a mysterious past. Their journey quickly turns into a terrifying ordeal as the darkest elements of human nature and the deadliest threats of the wilderness lead to an all-out fight for survival.
